messages_orig.content: Findings: I am 70 years old with high blood pressure. Over the past two months, my morning readings have usually been around 145/90, and my evening readings about 135/85. I take a diuretic and an ACE inhibitor every day. My recent lab results are all within normal ranges. My average salt intake is moderate, about half a teaspoon of added salt per day.
